annotations.message: V-carve inlay pockets maintain minimum 1.5mm clearance from the fingerboard binding edge.
V-bit angle (60°) requires a reduced feed rate in hard maple to avoid tip burning.
annotations.recommended_action: Verify feed rate is reduced to 80% for dense hardwoods.

annotations.message: Inlay pocket depth (3.2mm) approaches the maple cap thickness over the mahogany body.
annotations.recommended_action: Confirm maple cap thickness is at least 4.5mm in the inlay region before proceeding.
